recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a young man positioned off-center against a distressed, light-colored wall. The composition features a bold circular emblem and clean sans-serif text on the left, balancing the subject's presence on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at viewer to establish connection
Negative space on the left provides a canvas for branding
Textured background provides grit to an otherwise clean studio portrait
Deep shadows in the clothing contrast with the light, neutral background
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with a single muted accent color
Subtle vertical crease or crack texture in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark, bold typography on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves left to the logo and name, then down the vertical texture of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side, utilized for graphic elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochromatic tones plus one muted warm accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text to maintain clean, modern branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern feel.
Provides a similar wide, open geometric appearance.
Classic geometric sans-serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated portrait of a young man with spiky hair wearing a dark v-neck t-shirt. He is positioned on the right side of the frame against a light grey, textured wall with a subtle vertical crack. The lighting is soft but directional, creating depth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a circular logo in deep burgundy above a line of bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in black. Position these elements in the center-left negative space, aligned horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the text uppercase and widely tracked?
Is the logo a muted burgundy color?
Is the subject positioned to the right?
Is the background textured and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the burgundy accent
Tracking width of the display text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background
Verify the desaturated color grading is consistent
Check that the logo does not overlap the subject
Confirm the vertical crease texture is subtle and not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, off-center subject portrait with a textured neutral background and bold, geometric sans-serif branding in the negative space.
